<thought>The 13C NMR shows six signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm): one at 138.76 ppm, two at 131.45 ppm, two at 130.59 ppm, and one at 121.30 ppm. Counting each carbon represented by these signals gives a total of 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
